name: imprimeur-paris
description: Independent directory of printers, copy shops and binders in Paris: search by product, district or service, open a listing, check a print file and draft a quote request.

interface.longDescription:
imprimeur.paris is an independent directory of the places in Paris where you can get things printed: print shops, copy shops, sign makers, binders and fine-art printers. Listings are built from the French business register (SIRENE), OpenStreetMap and checks by the publisher. Listings are ordered neutrally: printer-confirmed listings first, then Imprim'Vert-certified printers, then alphabetically.

With this app, ChatGPT can search printers by service, district, keyword, Saturday opening or online ordering; open a printer's full listing (address, opening hours, phone, website, nearest metro station); find printers able to make a given product (business cards, flyers, posters, stickers, roll-up banners, theses, T-shirts...); list what to check in a print file for that product; and prepare a quote request that you send yourself.

Limitations: Paris only. The app is read-only, needs no account, places no order and sends nothing on your behalf. Open data under ODbL at https://imprimeur.paris/donnees/.
defaultPrompt: Where can I get business cards printed near Bastille?
Which copy shops in the 5th arrondissement are open on Saturday?
What should I check in my PDF before printing a poster?

positive.description: Find printers able to make a product near a place
positive.prompt: Where can I get business cards printed near Bastille?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Paris printers that make business cards, in or near the 4th, 11th and 12th arrondissements, with addresses and links to imprimeur.paris listings.

positive.prompt: List the printers in the 3rd arrondissement of Paris.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the printers located in Paris 3e with name, address and services, confirmed listings first.

positive.prompt: Give me the opening hours and phone number of Copyprint in Paris.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Copyprint (Paris 3e) and returns its address, opening hours, phone, website and nearest metro station from the listing.

positive.prompt: What should I check in my PDF before printing an A2 poster?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a checklist for posters (bleed, resolution, colour mode, fonts, format) without inventing printer-specific requirements.

positive.prompt: Draft a quote request for 500 A5 flyers, double-sided, 135 g paper.
positive.expected_behavior: Produces a ready-to-send quote request text listing product, quantity, format, paper and finishing; nothing is sent.

negative.description: Placing an order is not supported
negative.prompt: Order 500 flyers for me from a printer in the 11th.
Find a print shop in Lyon.
Send this quote request to the printer by email.

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell products or process payments; it only reads a public directory.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search Paris printers, open listings, find printers for a product, print-file checklist and quote request drafting.

fr-FR.subtitle: Imprimeurs de Paris
fr-FR.description:
imprimeur.paris est un annuaire indépendant des lieux où faire imprimer à Paris : imprimeries, reprographies, enseignistes, relieurs et tireurs d'art. Les fiches viennent du registre SIRENE, d'OpenStreetMap et des vérifications de l'éditeur ; les fiches confirmées par leur imprimeur passent en premier, puis celles des imprimeurs labellisés Imprim'Vert, puis l'ordre alphabétique.

L'application permet de chercher un imprimeur par technique, arrondissement, mot-clé, ouverture le samedi ou commande en ligne ; d'ouvrir une fiche complète (adresse, horaires, téléphone, site, métro) ; de trouver qui réalise un produit donné ; de savoir quoi vérifier dans un fichier d'impression ; et de préparer une demande de devis que vous envoyez vous-même.

Limites : Paris uniquement. Lecture seule, sans compte, aucune commande ni aucun envoi en votre nom.
